Emit TypeScript through openapi-typescript and the existing pnpm generate/typecheck convention. The directories in owned_paths are exclusive generated roots: only the handwritten __init__.py/build.py and package.json/tsconfig.json enumerated at docs/tdd/E01.md:718, plus manifest-enumerated generated leaves, are allowed. Never add a handwritten shared wire type, claim an unlisted generated file or delete it. Preserve base/effective/overlay hashes; A3 traceability allows accepted decisions only. Require the coordinator-owned allocations and E20 signature artifacts; test missing/untraced/invalid artifacts as failures. No pending observation policy, medicine terms, sync routes or health extension enters the overlay.

Implement every SYSTEM 5 kernel declaration in its exact named kernel file and all bounded in-memory counterparts in kernel/testing.py. The only pure generated dependency is contracts_gen.enums; keep contracts_gen/__init__.py import-safe, without eager Pydantic imports. Copy full protocols, dataclass fields, type aliases, literals and keyword-only methods, not abbreviated seam-table versions. Fakes cover UoW rollback/savepoints/buffered events, immutable snapshots, clocks/segments, config pins/checks, complete command identities/intents, audit, scheduler generations, tasks/evaluation, replica/ownership, private/vault and settings ports using injected IDs/time only. They model documented semantics, never provide production defaults. Do not build a second framework, fake SQL engine or real SQLite in kernel. Unit/golden helpers require_id, derived ID canonicalization, finite Quantity and audit preimage follow SYSTEM 5.1/5.4/5.9 exactly; UUIDv7 sources, OS clocks and crypto I/O remain adapters.

app/registry.py supplies the exact ModuleRegistry, Resolver and StartupPhase of SYSTEM 5.12 with declaration/graph/freeze support needed by module tests, not create_app. Build discovery/static import generation and app/import_contracts.py follow SYSTEM 6.4: sorted first-party module.py convention, bounded explicit requires graph, late optional bindings, no import-time I/O or configuration import paths, duplicate/cycle/missing-provider failures, and installed manifest verification. Generated imports are build outputs, not new handwritten feature lists. A signed build-catalog binding with no allocated artifact path is a PLAN Request, not an invented trust file. Modules contribute their own architecture.toml/replica.schema.json/settings through the documented convention; later epics edit no E01 file. A missing mandatory loader contributor still fails freeze in the real assembly; foundation tests may exercise the declaration registry without claiming a served release.

Write test_interfaces.py and test_properties.py first for T-E01-01 and the discovery part of T-E01-02 (R01/R06 and kernel/discovery invariants). Extract the full section-5 interface inventory and compare real runtime signatures/types, exercise every fake protocol and immutable/rollback bound, and independently check canonical ID/hash/units/time cases. The temporary feature-module regression in test_interfaces.py must prove ports/router/projection/task/evaluator/private writer/settings are discovered and import rules include it with no shared edit. Test direct kernel sqlite3 and transitive framework ingress, forbidden I/O even under TYPE_CHECKING, dynamic imports, missing/unlisted build modules, cycles and undeclared factory lookups. The AST walk uses SYSTEM 5's exact standard-library allowlist and trusted terminal-module rule. test_sha_guard.py proves changed/missing/extra base copies and package inventory mismatches fail, and effective replacements retain explicit supersession evidence. Repeated generation must compare bytes in temporary outputs without git. Failure cases are corrupt/missing source or manifest, parser bounds/nonfinite/duplicate data and deterministic retries; no accepted runtime data or network/device dependency exists yet. Foundation green means importable typed protocols/fakes/registry, guarded generated enums/models and toolchains genuinely pass, not stubs postponed to T6.

Foundation scope limit: do not add feature scaffolds, persistence, optional-worker packages or safety behavior. Generate the schema inventory once for the required kernel enums and retain that same generation pipeline for full E01 contract acceptance; never build separate bootstrap enums. Before dispatch, the coordinator must supply the accepted D12 allocations and signed input/build manifest binding. This is a true prerequisite to these gates, not a dependency on a completed E20 runtime. No coder can turn missing trust inputs into an unsigned production fallback.

Submit, claim and complete are short transactions; external execute is outside writes with bounded lease/attempt/timeout. Cancel increments generation before worker stop; stale completion returns false and discards. Job progress is Quantity(unit=1) in [0,1]; authorized result projection is typed EvidenceKind or null, never relabel an internal string. Internal tasks return NOT_FOUND through public getJob. Evaluation catches only allowlisted EvaluatorComputationFailure under savepoint; validated input, pending marker, original release/time/version, retry and audit commit together. Every forbidden storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config/input exception escapes; marker/audit failure aborts. Successful retry resolves marker/effects/completion together; old input cannot overwrite newer safety state. Health derives from committed markers.

Unknown projection/resource kind denies. Ownership prepare/fence/accept/complete is local durable CAS; never timeout election. Signed transport validation and agreed resource-specific snapshots remain external/provider bindings, not table dumps. File/HTTP transport and routine/supply workflows belong to E20/E29/E25/E32. No invented sync HTTP operation.

SYSTEM 5.8.1/7.2/7.4: implement PrivateRecordCoordinator.write/publish/delete/recover/backup_barrier and PrivatePublicationRejected using E02 PrivateKeyVault and E03/E09 PrivateStore/PrivateReferenceWriter. Lock order is barrier, private seal, hub write, private receipt. Verify HMAC/owner/live reference/current revocation; ACK only after both stores. A false task publication callback aborts attach, stale drafts cannot publish, and missing ciphertext is an integrity fault. Deletion remains pending until every registered vault replica attests; current revocation survives old data restore. Backup pauses every private writer and key allocator, captures paired WAL-consistent snapshots at one watermark and verifies all references. Do not implement the missing encrypted archive/maintenance/pristine-init/signing/compatibility interfaces of R-E01-19/20/24 by guessing. Staging and verification may proceed; install/restore/rollback enablement remains blocked until these bindings exist. E02 owns vault implementation, E03/E09 their ciphertext tables. R-E01-21 blocks the hard Python callback deadline claim: SQLite progress handlers do not interrupt stalled Python.

Events implement SYSTEM 5.7/8.3 and E01 section 5. Store every StoredEvent field and mandatory registered local audience exactly once, validate generated Event payloads, and publish SSE only after commit. GET /v1/events getEvents returns generated EventPage for application/json or SSE with the contracted 15-second comment heartbeat. Bounded raw scanning advances next_cursor to last scanned even if invisible; has_more reports remaining raw rows, not visible count. Missing audience or closed/revoked/partial grant withholds the entire fixed payload. Recheck current session generation at delivery/heartbeat once R-E01-18 is agreed. Every durable subscriber effect and cursor shares a new UoW; poison input cannot be skipped. Retention uses SQL guards and an authorized monotonic watermark below both age and all subscriber cursors with trusted_schema=OFF, never a Python trigger UDF. Total stream overflow across distinct sessions rejects before headers with retryable INTERNAL_ERROR, never evicts accepted work.
